Using the corrected equation:
\[
\sin\alpha(\sin 80^\circ+\sqrt3\sin 10^\circ)=\sin 80^\circ.
\]
Since \(\sin 80^\circ=\cos 10^\circ\),
\[
\sin 80^\circ+\sqrt3\sin 10^\circ=\cos 10^\circ+\sqrt3\sin 10^\circ
=2\sin(30^\circ+10^\circ)=2\sin40^\circ.
\]
Thus
\[
2\sin\alpha\sin40^\circ=\sin80^\circ=2\sin40^\circ\cos40^\circ,
\]
so
\[
\sin\alpha=\cos40^\circ=\sin50^\circ.
\]
Since \(\alpha\) is acute,
\[
\boxed{50^\circ}
\]
